reviews.text:
I do not like writing reviews, but this feels necessary. My cat was sent home with 10x the amount of antibiotic he needed. He’s a 4.5 kg cat and was sent home with 450mg instead of 45mg. CVH called me to notify me of their mistake the next day and instructed me to come back and swap the meds out for the correct dosage. The tech who dispensed the original incorrect med was rude, condescending, and was talking to me like I was slow — turns out it was her mistake.

Receptionist told me the medical director approved a refund of my whole $299 visit, but they only reimbursed me for the corrected $35 medication. Since posting this review, CVH cancelled my $299 refund which I’ve now had to dispute with my credit card company.

I did not appreciate the medical director Dr. Christian Croquenois telling me he’s “not sure how this could have been prevented.” My trust is completely broken with this practice. Not to mention it took over a month to receive results from my other cat’s echocardiogram after numerous phone calls and polite in person reminders.

I started this review with 3 stars but have dropped it down to 1 due to abhorrent service and responses from this practice. I really hope nothing like this happens again to any patient, but it’s important for the public to know that this happened. Thank God urgent care confirmed that my cat was okay and that he had overdosed on a medication with a relatively forgiving margin of safety.

I have waited a long time to post this because I don’t have an alternative vet. But my experience here continues to be mostly (with few exceptions) garbage. I have waited hours past my appointment time to be seen, even after being sat in a room.
The staff always say my pets name wrong, confuse their genders and have snarky attitudes when you ask them questions.
The vets themselves are helpful and I generally like them.
But the staff without fail give me attitude, and are just rude. Additionally, prepare to find fleas on your animals after every visit. I have never once come here and made it out without finding fleas on my pets and I’ve been coming here for close to three years. I chose to write this tonight after finding fleas on my cat who just had a kidney infection. Im so frustrated with the cleanliness and service here especially for the heft prices, you should not be writing a script for urinary food for the wrong cat and then arguing with me about fixing it. (Still not fixed btw after multiple calls)
Know what they're doing.

I’ve only truly loved two veterinary hospitals in my life, and Cahuenga Veterinary Hospital is one of them.

When our newly adopted kitten was diagnosed with FIP, we were devastated. The team at CVH guided us through one of the most stressful experiences we’ve had as pet owners. They carefully managed the necessary testing, medications, and expenses with both professionalism and compassion. Thanks to their excellent care, our kitten is now nearly two years old and has remained in FIP remission ever since.

Beyond their medical expertise, their communication, scheduling, and genuine empathy are exceptional. Every interaction has made us feel like our pets—and our concerns—truly matter.

Most recently, we accidentally showed up on the wrong day for an appointment. Even though the mistake was completely ours, the staff still went out of their way to try to accommodate us. That level of kindness and customer service is rare.

I also want to mention that we used Fetch Pet Insurance during our kitten’s FIP treatment, and it was invaluable in helping cover the significant costs of care. While that’s separate from the hospital itself, it made an incredibly difficult situation much more manageable.

I recommend Cahuenga Veterinary Hospital without hesitation. If you’re looking for a veterinary team that combines outstanding medical care with genuine compassion, this is the place.

First day at CVH and I really like the team here. Admin staff are professional, kind and efficient. We saw Dr.Lauren and she was excellent, she gave our pup a thorough exam and took great care to review her history and work around her epilepsy. Great energy from the team top to bottom. The clinic was busy, and it's easy to see why. I'm happy we have this team in our neighborhood.

I moved out to LA recently with my senior cat, and was recommended this place by a friend. My cat needs somewhat frequent vet visits and medication refills, and they established him right away. I’ve been with them about three months now, and I’ve been happy with the service so far. They aren’t any more pricey than my last vet, especially since I don’t have insurance to cover most of his visits. The staff remembers me and my cat and are always kind and explain everything

I called at 5:45 trying to get my dogs prescription refilled at a new pharmacy and he desperately needed his meds. I get put on hold for almost ten minutes then disconnected. I try calling back at 5:55 and they already set it to voicemail. Terrible. It says you’re open to 6, I get you want to get out as fast as possible but people pets are depending on you to be there when your hours say you will.

We have been bringing our cats and dog to this clinic for several years. The staff has always been friendly and caring, and we had many positive experiences with routine care, vaccinations, medications, Henry’s neuter surgery, and Oscar’s dental cleaning. However, we also experienced several recurring issues. We often waited more than an hour past our scheduled appointment time. On two occasions, medications prescribed by the veterinarian were not provided to us at checkout, and we had to drive back to pick them up. We also had difficulty obtaining eye medication for Henry, even though his condition seemed obvious and we were traveling at the time. The most concerning experience was with our kitten Skya. We came in already worried about FIP, but she was sent home for observation and later required emergency treatment when her condition worsened. We also wish our senior dog Oscar had been offered more treatment options instead of only supportive care.

Overall, the team is kind and genuinely cares about animals, but we hope to see improvements in communication, organization, wait times, and clinical decision-making. Despite these issues, we appreciate the kindness of the team and the care they have provided to our pets over the years. We truly hope these areas continue to improve because this clinic has the potential to provide an even better experience for both pets and their owners.

We are so grateful for CVH and always recommend them to our friends and family.

Dr. Croquenois is an incredibly knowledgeable, experienced, and honest vet. I was so relived to find him after many unfortunate vet experiences. The glowing reviews are all correct!

Dr. Boesgaard deserves equal recognition as a wonderful vet. She became our primary vet during one of our kitties’ final stages of life after a long battle with illness. She provided us with so much care, attention, and compassion. She made an incredibly difficult and painful time so much more bearable. I don’t even want to imagine what it would have been like going through it without her. She’s an absolute gem of a vet and person. We hold so much gratitude for her role in our pets’ lives.

It’s nice to look back and have no regrets or second thoughts about my kitty’s end of life care with Dr. B and Dr. C. And I appreciate that I always feel like the care is equally great, continuous, and collaborative no matter which vet I see.

I truly can’t say enough good things! I’m happy that our two current kitties (pictured in office) and all our future felines are in good hands ❤️

And they usually have fun stickers for the humans to paw through. A silly and sweet touch, especially when you’re going through it!

Original review after bringing in a foster cat in 2021:
Fantastic, helpful staff
An excellent veterinarian and wonderful people—they listen to you and explain your pet's treatment process. It is a great place.

Recently had to find a new vet clinic after moving and got referred to Cahuenga Vet Hospital from a friend. Awesome initial experience for an annual check-up for my dog Portia. Dr. Boesgaard and her staff took time to make my dog comfortable from the weight scale to her vaccine. Easy parking, clean clinic, easy going staff. Very happy to have found CVH.
Staffs are really kind they truly care about your family pet

My pitbull and I have been going to Dr. Croquenois and Dr. Boesgaard for over 2 years now. Their entire office has provided amazing care at super reasonable prices. Dr. Boesgaard did a very thorough body exam and found a lump I had not even noticed! They do their best to squeeze you in for emergency appointments and they work long hours to make sure all patients are cared for -- I have personally witnessed them stay late to care for my dog and have received phone calls from CVH in the early evening when they had test results to communicate to me (they didn't keep me waiting until the next business day!).

All of the staff have been kind, communicative, and knowledgeable in my experience. I like the fact that I recognize the same friendly faces at their office and that they triage patients, phone calls, and paperwork so professionally. There's limited parking out front, BUT there's usually ample street parking on Cahuenga Blvd or Cole Ave. I've referred their office to 2 lifelong Angelenos who have tried out other vet offices in the past and both of them have switched to make CVH their vet given the prime location, great pricing, and positive atmosphere.

I have nothing but great things to say about Cahuenga Veterinary Hospital. Dr. C and Dr. Boesgaard went above and beyond to help save my furry son’s life.
My fur son had a very severe reaction to an oral flea and tick medication, which caused him to develop acute pancreatitis. They immediately got him in and started a lifesaving treatment plan to help save his life.
Not only did they provide incredible medical care, but they also contacted the manufacturer of the flea and tick medication to report the negative reaction. The entire team truly did everything they could to make things right and to give my son the best chance possible.
They are a wonderful, caring veterinary clinic and the only vets I trust to take care of my furry children. Their compassion, professionalism, and dedication during such a scary time meant the world to me and my family.
They have earned my trust for life, and I wouldn’t take my furry children anywhere else. 🐾💙

I was in a pinch for a health certificate for my dog with a very small window to make it happen and they pulled through. Everyone I interacted with was so kind, understanding and helpful . They were familiar with what I needed and worked with me to meet the Airlines requirement in the letter, with a very quick turn around. I was able to make the flight and had everything I needed with their help. Thanks to the team at the front desk and the vets! I will be returning.

We have been bringing our dog to Cahuenga Veterinary Hospital for several years, and we are so grateful for the incredible care they provide. The doctor and the entire team are truly wonderful.
Every visit has been a great experience. Everyone is kind, patient, and always takes the time to explain everything clearly so we feel comfortable and informed about our dog’s care.
If you ever need an international health certificate for traveling with your pet, Diana is absolutely amazing. She goes above and beyond to help, carefully explains every step, and makes the whole process so much easier and less stressful.
The doctor always examines our dog with so much kindness, patience, and genuine love for animals. You can really feel how much he cares. He always gives thoughtful recommendations and makes sure our dog gets the best possible care.
We truly appreciate this clinic and the entire team. It’s such a comfort to know our dog is in such caring and professional hands. We highly recommend Cahuenga Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for a veterinarian who truly cares about their patients.🐕💛
Hello Angelica. We don’t have any patient under your name.

I’ve been coming to Cahuenga Veterinary for a few years for care of my two cats and have been consistently impressed with the level or care, staff, and assistance. I frequently have questions and they’re always willing to help me over the phone, and offer a same day appointment if something requires an extra look. Every appointment I’m offered an itemized bill before treatments beyond the standard exam fee so I can consent to the price and ask questions. One of my cats has urinary issues and I’m so grateful I can get same day appointments and care when needed so we can prevent things from turning critical.
Best vet we’ve been able to find in LA for our dogs and cat

Came recommended from a friend whose small rescue dog has endured many issues and Dr.C was the man. Dr. C gave us info we needed and a plan for our dogs betterment. He doesn't try and sell you everything and knows everyone has a budget. Nice clean facility and staff were above and beyond in the care of our lovely dog. Highly suggest this facility and Dr. C.

I love this vet!!!
Great service, great prices, and nice people!!!

Unfortunately, this was not a good experience. We arrived on time for the appointment and were taken back to the treatment room, but then were not seen, while other pets were seen. When I checked back in with the front desk, they appeared to not know who we were, when our appointment was, or when or if we would be seen. Bad all around.

UPDATE:  This issue was promptly--and graciously--resolved with a follow up appointment the following day and free exam.  It is refreshing for a veterinary practice to acknowledge and address a concern so quickly and directly.  We will be returning.
Parking is bad, but that is the only downside.

Ignore the negative reviews.  This is a wonderful clinic and its clear the staff genuinely care about the animals they treat.  Dr. C is very knowledgable and attentive, and has never pushed unnecessary treatments the way other providers sometimes do.  The phones are ringing 24/7 and it's clear the clinic is extremely busy, but if you book appointments ahead of time and come in prepared, you’ll get respectful, professional care every time.
Dr. C is the best!
This is a very good veterinary office. You can tell they truly care about your pets. The energy is positive, and the staff are professional and kind.

We came in to check out our Bernedoodles ear infection and learned so much more about his health! He’s always been a picky eater, we thought he was just selective but turns out he likely has allergies! We are excited to work with Cahuenga to fatten him up and get him comfortable. Thank you to everyone from the warm and insightful reception team to all the vets for transparent information and pricing.

Scotty my beloved service dog beagle just had two benign tumours removed.

A smaller one at the base of his tail and one on his side.

Once Dr Christian opened him up, and it was no longer compressed, this growth turned out to be even bigger than a grapefruit.

The surgery proved challenging, when he discovered just how deeply attached this fatty deposit was.

A lesser surgeon would have struggled to remove it all. And you can find some cheaper vets in LA, but if you want to have priceless peace of mind about your furry friend, this vet practice is the place.

Scotty is healing beautifully and now he no longer looks pregnant & is starting to move like a happy show pony.

We take both our dogs here and the vets listen really well to what’s going on with your animals. Lots of care snd consideration for sure. The support staff are equally attentive so makes for a very good experience for not only our dogs- but us as well!

Unorganized and very much so just about money. You go in for a problem and they try to sell you a million other products and services. The 2 vets aren’t thorough at all. You pay extra to see the “doctor” just for them to rub your pet few times and peek in the ears. This place is a joke. I will not be returning. If you actually care about the health of your pet and what your concerns addressed properly DO NOT COME TO THIS OVERPRICED place of horror.

I’ve been taking my dog here for the past 4 years since he was a puppy. Although outrageous prices, I’ve never had a problem with them or the staff. My last visit was the most unprofessional ever. I took my pet for ear infection troubles, anal gland expression, vaccines, fleas. All the wellness stuff. During the viewing of my first invoice I saw that anal gland expression wasn’t added so I went to the front desk and told her I had told the vet tech to put the expression but it’s not on the invoice so she calls the back and says to do the expression while giving me the new invoice. I had just got pet insurance and was trying to file the claim on my insurance app. I needed help inputting the diagnosis from the invoice to the claim on my app. Basic matching information, nothing hard but I just wanted to clarify that the information matched so I was certain my insurance would pay for it. You’d think a simple “ yes this matches “ or “ no you can add/remove this “ would suffice but instead the vet tech that I’ve seen for years comes around and goes “ what are you trying to do? what is this? “ I explain what I’m trying to do and he gives me attitude and says they don’t do that and I have to go through my insurance. Then rudely walks away. I speak to the other front desk worker and he completely understood what I was trying to say and was giving me advice on what he thinks would work. They let me leave without my prescription credelio pill for my dog, it was only when I realized and went back that they gave it to me. It’s now been 4 days since the visit and my dog has still been licking his butt and the fishy smell is still there so that let’s me know that the anal gland expression was not even done. Rude and unprofessional staff and AWFUL prices. $51 to pluck hair from my dogs ears?! Save your time and money.
